search.note: Accepts a natural-language query. Include the current year when searching for recent information. Returns sourced result blocks; always carry the source URLs into the lead record.

web_read.note: Accepts a URL and returns readable markdown. Large pages may be summarized; for raw HTML, PDFs, or directory listings prefer the shell fallback. Authenticated pages are unavailable — use public sources only.

linkedin.note: No login-gated LinkedIn access by default. Use public LinkedIn pages via web_read/shell, or a LinkedIn MCP when its session is verified. Never guess profile URLs.
